families.G0: installed exact source predicate; diagnostic baseline only
families.G1: Euclidean distance outside the exact source volume/band, or hypot(horizontal surface gap, vertical surface gap) for object supports
families.G2: dimensionless semantic compatibility using region half-sizes or object radii/heights
families.G3: G2 bounded to [0,1), plus an exact-predicate stratum offset of one for non-matches

site_on.horizontal: bowl center relative to site half-widths

site_in.volume: site half-sizes with 0.01 m lower-z allowance

object_support.horizontal: center distance and sum of horizontal radii
object_support.vertical: absolute gap between orientation-aware bowl bottom and support top

confidence.unique: finite best score within family maximum and gap strictly above threshold
confidence.not_found: nonfinite or best score above maximum
